title: Influencer marketing worldwide - statistics & facts
description: Considering millions of users browse social media each day for entertainment, inspiration, and shopping cues, it is no wonder influencer marketing has seen impressive growth over the past few years. In 2025, the global influencer marketing market value was estimated to reach over 32 billion U.S. dollars, up by 35 percent compared to the previous year. As the industry evolves, influencer marketing platforms are experiencing consistent growth in both scale and value. This ongoing expansion is making brand-creator partnerships increasingly lucrative year after year.
